What the engine does

Briefs and dossiers

These are not the same thing as the research dossiers, and the difference is worth stating. A dossier is about the literature: what has been published on a subject, who disagrees with whom, and which widely repeated figures do not survive checking. A brief is about this instrument: what it computes, how, and what it leaves out.

They are rendered from the working files the project keeps, so what is here is the working record itself — including the passages recording that something was got wrong and corrected.
